target_customer: Designers and front-end developers at software companies who build animations and design systems
problem: Hand-off between design and engineering is slow, so animations and brand tokens are rebuilt in code by hand.
business_model: Developer tooling: freemium desktop app and team plans, with open-source components
product_category: Design to code tooling (animation editor, design tokens, marketing optimizer)

founders.name: Zack Brown
founders.background_notes: The YC page lists Zack Brown as the only founder and gives no background. No source opened gave education or prior employers.

technical_complexity.rationale: A desktop animation editor that exports to code needs a rendering runtime and framework bindings, which is standard engineering with some hard parts for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Animation and design tools were easy for larger design vendors to extend, and the team later open-sourced core components, which limited lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found in the sources opened. The search found no sale or sunset notice.

market_need_then: Design to code hand-off was a known pain point for product teams in 2017 and 2018, though the sources opened give no spend or usage data for Haiku itself.

branding.domain_note: Used haikuforteams.com rather than a plain .com, per the YC page and the company site URL.

rebrands.to: Haiku for Teams plus separate product brands Diez and Haiku Optimizer
rebrands.why: The YC page lists three separately named products. The reason is not sourced.

branding.community_and_virality: The Animator launched on Product Hunt (listing dated March 2019) and a School of Motion podcast interviewed the CEO. No merch or fan activity found.

brand_strength.rationale: A common real word shared with Haiku Deck and the Haiku operating system made search results noisy, and the company split into several product names. Press about the brand itself was thin.

outcome_analysis: The YC directory marks Haiku inactive but no shutdown notice, acquisition or post-mortem was found, so the cause is not public. The company spread across three product lines in design, branding and marketing, which suggests an unfocused strategy, but no source states that. The only funding figure is a single database entry for a 2018 seed.
notes: The company site returned HTTP 503 so it was not read. The seed round of 3M dated 2018-04 with Kyle Vogt rests on a single database (startupintros) and could not be tied to a second outlet. CB Insights and VCBacked show other companies named Haiku with different rounds; they were excluded. No dated competitor source near the W18 batch was found; alternativeto and stackshare pages are undated so the list is empty.
